verdict.rationale: QBO offers built-in automations (bank rules, auto-reminders, auto-reconciliation, Payroll AI proactively pulling data) and an official MCP server exposing 145 tools for AI-agent integration, which supports building autonomous background workflows. However, there's no direct evidence of a native no-code 'automation builder' for arbitrary agentic workflows, and community feedback notes QBO lacks some automation depth compared to desktop.
